prompt: A conference room with a long rectangular table in the center, around which are arranged six chairs. A presenter stands at a whiteboard at the head of the table. On the whiteboard are several hand-drawn diagrams. The presenter holds a marker. A projection screen, which is narrower than the whiteboard, is mounted on the wall behind the presenter, displaying a bar chart. The number of diagrams on the whiteboard is greater than the number of bars in the chart. A laptop is placed on the table in front of the presenter. Next to the laptop is a glass of water and a cup containing some pens; the number of pens is half the number of chairs. A conference phone is positioned at the table’s center. A clock is mounted above the projection screen. The presenter is pointing at the whiteboard. The laptop is closer to the presenter than to the phone.
